scientific_integrity: Analytical proof of the single ball-landing probability crossover for all integer dimensions at least three; diagnostic calculations are ancillary and not an infinite-dimensional certificate.
scientific_limitations: Centered balls and normalized, idealized radial exponential and isotropic Gaussian kernels with equal mean-squared displacement only. No empirical dispersal inference; dimensions one and two excluded. Historical-priority assessment is provisional and has not undergone independent validation.
title: One disk-coverage crossover for moment-matched exponential and Gaussian dispersal in dimensions at least three
